record.title: Mesa Ridge INV-MR-03 nuisance DC overcurrent trips
record.symptom: INV-MR-03 trips on DC overcurrent two to four times per afternoon with no measured overcurrent
record.fix: Firmware 3.2.0 raised the DC overcurrent debounce; trips stopped the same day
record.outcome: No trips in the 30 days after the upgrade
limitations: Only one unit; fuses were replaced first, so their effect cannot be separated
